claims: UCLA women's basketball won their first NCAA Division I National Championship on April 5, 2026.
UCLA women's basketball defeated South Carolina 79-51 in the championship game.
The championship game was in Phoenix.
The Bruins finished the 2025-26 season with a 37-1 record.
Gabriela Jaquez scored 21 points in the final game.

Date of the 2026 NCAA Championship: April 5, 2026.
Venue of the 2026 NCAA Championship: Mortgage Matchup Center, Phoenix, AZ.
